name: Financial Instrument Reporting Reference Data Report V 02
definition: This FinancialInstrumentReportingReferenceDataReport message is sent by the trading venue to the national competent authority to report on the reference data used in the securities transactions.

ReportHeader.name: Report Header
ReportHeader.definition: Header information related to the global report.

ReferenceData.name: Reference Data
ReferenceData.definition: Details of the reference data reported by the trading venue.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
